title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists the hydrosphere's mass as 1.4 × 10^21 kg
summary: The fact sheet lists the total mass of the hydrosphere as 1.4 × 10^21 kilograms.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists the total mass of the hydrosphere as 1.4 × 10^21 kilograms. That is a mass, not the saline share of the water and not the ocean's volume. Those are other cards.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
